business.title: Engineered to delight consumers while fiercely protecting corporate budgets
business.subtitle: Traditional paper scratch-offs and sweepstakes suffer from cloning, insider leaks, and plummeting engagement. Our platform neutralizes every bottleneck with banking-grade technology.

cards.title: Zero Friction for the Consumer
cards.desc: Operates natively with any smartphone camera (iOS or Android). No heavy app store downloads, no mandatory upfront 10-step forms prior to scanning.

cards.title: Absolute Budget Control
cards.desc: Prizes trigger exclusively under strict business rules, hourly distribution quotas, and hard budget caps. Never will an unauthorized or out-of-budget prize be awarded.

cards.title: Live Telemetry & Metrics
cards.desc: Real-time visibility into scan velocity, geo-heatmaps, peak retail trading hours, and redemption conversion curves to guide dynamic marketing decisions.

cards.title: Universal Print & Media Compatibility
cards.desc: Integrates seamlessly across any industrial print format: scratch-off labels, bottle caps, flexible pouches, packaging carton, in-store POS receipts, or event wristbands.

security.title: Banking-Grade Security Explained in Plain Language
security.subtitle: For brand managers and CFOs, the nightmare scenario is printing leaks or viral duplicate redemption via messaging apps. Our architecture eliminates these vulnerabilities at their root.

pillars.title: The Blind Key (Unique Cryptographic Tokens)
pillars.metaphor: Printed codes do not contain the prize inside them.
pillars.desc: Each QR contains only a high-entropy pseudo-random cryptographic token. No print shop worker or packaging vendor can ascertain whether a ticket carries a prize. The assignment verdict is computed by the secure server cluster at the exact millisecond the consumer scans.

pillars.title: Single-Use Atomic Lock
pillars.metaphor: A digital banknote that self-retires once redeemed.
pillars.desc: The moment a user validates a winning or entry code, the database transaction atomically switches state to 'CONSUMED' with UTC timestamp and encrypted IP signature. Attempting to rescan or share a screenshot triggers immediate rejection and audit logging.

pillars.title: Bot Shield & Dynamic Rate Limiting
pillars.metaphor: An AI gatekeeper thwarting suspicious velocity patterns.
pillars.desc: Automated algorithms detect and quarantine brute-force token guessing, distributed scraper bots, and click farms. Requests are throttled per IP and device fingerprint to ensure equitable consumer fairness.

steps.title: Blind Generation
steps.desc: Pre-hashed cryptographic tokens exported to print partners under AES-256 encryption.

steps.title: Encrypted Scan
steps.desc: Consumer scans via native lens over authenticated HTTPS / TLS 1.3 channels.

steps.title: Atomic Verdict
steps.desc: Cloud cluster evaluates state, fraud rules, and budget limits in under 100ms.

steps.title: Locked Voucher
steps.desc: Prize claimed, locked with unique redemption hash, and permanently logged in audit trails.
